translations.web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
translations.bsb: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
translations.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
